rationale: The round-4 discourse has become a stable, highly structured impasse: the employee side and Lower Saxony remain fixed on no closures/no compulsory redundancies, while management, owners, and investors still require durable structural savings and keep closures on the table. The expert scenario work has clarified trade-offs but has not resolved the core conflict, and further rounds are unlikely to change the substantive positions without a targeted intervention to force quantified concessions or a decision point.
